body.sr: Nook je počeo od jednog ostrva. Siros, u Kikladima — kuće od kreča, barovi mali i bez ukrasa. Ništa tamo nije novo, i ništa se ne pretvara da jeste.
body.en: Nook started with an island. Syros, in the Cyclades — limewashed houses, small bars with nothing on the walls. Nothing there is new, and nothing pretends to be.

body.sr: Nismo hteli da napravimo grčki bar u Leskovcu. Uzeli smo ono što se prenosi: obične materijale, meru u svemu, i sobu u kojoj je razgovor glasniji od muzike.
body.en: We did not set out to make a Greek bar in Leskovac. We took what travels: ordinary materials, restraint in everything, and a room where the conversation is louder than the music.

body.sr: Otvorili smo 19. juna, u ulici Koste Stamenkovića 23 — iza vrata koja se lako promaše.
body.en: We opened on 19 June, at Koste Stamenkovića 23 — behind a door that is easy to miss.
